criteria.requirement: Distinguish future personal services from existing transferable assets.

criteria.fail: Calls both contributions cash or categorically treats future work as existing paid-up property, or assumes Nadia owns transferable rights.

criteria.minimalPass: Luc's six months of future work are industry, not paid-up capital/property; Nadia's existing files may be in-kind only after ownership, transferability and valuation checks.

criteria.pass: States the ordinary Luxembourg SARL requires at least €12,000 social capital and Luc's €9,500 future services cannot bridge the €2,500 cash to that minimum; calls for additional eligible funding or verified asset value.
criteria.fail: Accepts €2,500 plus future work as €12,000 paid-up capital or imports the SARL-S €1 floor.

factRefs.quote: The €2,500 cash plus Luc's work clears the ordinary Luxembourg SARL's capital requirement.

criteria.minimalPass: €2,500 plus industry does not make €12,000 capital; obtain qualifying cash/assets.

criteria.requirement: Reconcile the actual older doctrine and later SARL industry-share statute.
criteria.pass: Explains that the older précis excluded remuneration by SARL social shares while distinguishing exclusion from capital, whereas the 18 May 2026 statutory provision permits articles-defined noncapital industry shares. Corrects the draft's absolute inference without suggesting the older précis ever claimed industry counted toward capital. Statutory economic and transfer rights are scored only in 14-04.
criteria.fail: Treats the older statement about noncapital status as false under the new statute, or relies on older exclusion to deny the statutory SARL industry-share route.

sourceRefs.quote: les statuts déterminent les modalités selon lesquelles peuvent être souscrites des parts sociales en industrie
peuvent pas être rémunérés par droits sociaux (actions, parts sociales)

factRefs.quote: no services-based shares are possible because our 2018 précis says so

criteria.minimalPass: The older précis denied SARL social-share remuneration but also excluded industry from capital; the later 2026 statute now permits articles-defined, noncapital SARL industry shares, so the draft's absolute ban is wrong.
criteria.nearMiss: The 2018 précis said industry formed capital, and the 2026 statute first excluded it.

criteria.requirement: Correct the proposed ordinary SARL industry-share rights and transferability.
criteria.pass: Drafts a conditional articles provision for Luc's industry shares; states the statutory profit/net-asset and loss rights and that industry shares are nontransferable, rather than promising transferable capital shares or automatically granting a vote unsupported by cited material.
criteria.fail: Promises fully transferable industry shares or treats Luc's requested vote as automatically supplied by the industry contribution.

sourceRefs.quote: Les parts attribuées en contrepartie d’apports en industrie sont incessibles et intransmissibles.

factRefs.quote: issue fully transferable industry shares with no articles provision
Luc wants an economic upside and a vote

criteria.minimalPass: Articles may define Luc's noncapital industry shares with profit and net-asset participation and loss contribution; shares are intransmissible, while his requested vote needs specific legal/drafting confirmation rather than automatic grant.
criteria.nearMiss: Luc automatically receives freely transferable voting capital shares for work.

criteria.requirement: Use SCS permission without erasing partner roles and liability.

criteria.minimalPass: SCS admits industry under its contract but needs distinct general and limited partners; a commandité bears unlimited joint liability, so ask which founder accepts that still-unassigned role and negotiate rights rather than presume identical rights.

criteria.fail: Applies Belgian no-capital regime to Luxembourg SARL or certifies Belgian law unchanged since the 2021 doctrinal account.
